statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to characterize arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
The service code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on missing required precertification or authorization
The required prior authorization was missing
